selection_reasoning: These two tasks form a coherent multi-hop sequence. The player must first mine gray_concrete_powder to clear a path or reveal access to a lava source, and then pick up lava with a bucket. The scene can be designed so that the gray_concrete_powder blocks are obstructing direct access to a lava pool, requiring the player to mine through them before being able to reach and collect the lava. This creates a natural dependency where the mining task enables the lava collection task. Both tasks are observable (block removal and lava bucket in inventory) and don't require deep Minecraft knowledge beyond basic mining and bucket usage.

milestones.description: Uses inventory_has because when gray concrete powder is mined (with any tool or hand), it drops as an item that enters the player's inventory. This avoids the gravity-mechanic complication where voxel counting is unreliable (blocks fall within the same bounding box when lower blocks are mined). The player starts with no gray_concrete_powder in inventory, so having at least 1 confirms they mined it.

Uses inventory_has because when a player right-clicks a lava source block with a bucket, the bucket is consumed and a lava_bucket item appears in their inventory. The player starts with an empty bucket and no lava_bucket, so having at least 1 lava_bucket confirms they successfully collected lava.

scene_description: A sealed room made of gray concrete powder walls (1-block thick, 3 blocks high) with a stone ceiling encloses a 3x3 lava pool. The lava sits on an obsidian base with a 1-block air gap between the lava and all walls, preventing lava flow when the wall is breached. The player spawns nearby with an iron shovel (optimal tool for concrete powder) and a bucket. Fire resistance is applied to protect against accidental lava contact. The player must mine through the gray concrete powder wall to access the interior, then use the bucket to collect lava from the source blocks.
task_text: Mine through the gray concrete powder wall to reach the lava pool inside, then pick up the lava with your bucket.

Interior air space: ~4,~0,~3 to ~8,~2,~7 (5x3x5). Lava pool: ~5,~0,~4 to ~7,~0,~6 (3x3, 9 source blocks on obsidian). Air gap of 1 block on all sides between lava and walls prevents lava flow when wall is breached. Player spawns at origin with iron shovel (fastest tool for concrete powder), bucket, and fire resistance. The closest wall face is the south wall at z=2, approximately 3 blocks from spawn.
